ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels occupy approximately 85% of the visible surface, contrasted by low-intensity black pigmentation along the distal trailing edges and at the central peduncle attachment point.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary white contiguous region across the center of both lobes. Black pigmentation is mapped as a continuous band along the trailing edge, increasing in thickness at the lobe tips. Small, high-contrast black focal spots are scattered in the mid-to-distal regions of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 105 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular trailing edge with high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations. Notable peaks and deeper valleys are visible on the outer 20% of both the left and right lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a sigmoidal curve, exhibiting slight convexity near the median notch before transitioning to a concave sweep towards the elevated tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-intensity (white) circular pixel clusters are visible, notably a cluster of four in the lower-mid quadrant of the right lobe and several isolated spots on the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct, dark linear pixel disruption (rake mark) is visible on the right lobe, extending diagonally from the mid-section toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Circular scarring clusters (likely barnacle attachment sites) and at least one prominent linear abrasion on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A dark, triangular pigmentation zone is visible at the central base of the fluke where it joins the peduncle.
